Turnkey duplex with great investment potential! This property is perfect for investors or owner-occupants looking to generate immediate rental income while living in one unit. Unit B is currently vacant and can be shown at any time, while Unit A is tenant-occupied with a lease through 6/30/2026. Each unit offers two bedrooms with walk-in closets, one bathroom, spacious living areas, granite countertops in the kitchens, and large, fenced backyards. Both units feature ceramic tile throughout the main living areas, with the bedrooms carpeted. Unit A includes white appliances and recent updates such as an HVAC system installed in May 2024, new carpet in June 2023, and new tile in June 2023. Unit B boasts a travertine backsplash and stainless-steel appliances, along with a dishwasher replaced in July 2024. Out back, both units have insulated patio covers designed to decrease heat transfer, and each has a large, private, fenced yard. The duplex is situated on approximately 0.33 acres at the end of a quiet, dead-end street, providing no neighbors on one side for added privacy. Conveniently located near Copperas Cove City Park with easy access to shopping, restaurants, and Ft Hood.
